name: AgentGuard
description: Local-runtime spend governance and signed audit receipts for AI agents. Wraps OpenAI, Anthropic, and Bedrock SDKs with pre-dispatch dollar caps (tenant / team / user / agent / task), capability-gated routing, and Ed25519-signed hash-chained receipts. Extends natively to x402 USDC outflows. Six US provisional patents on the runtime architecture. AGENTGUARD US trademark Serial 99462472. Live on npm + PyPI.
